knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the client buys the finished result, with certainty that the walls will look right. Your rate, your ute or your years in business are not what the offer sells.
The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford. Open-ended, impossible or limited-audience guarantees do not meet that test.
The lesson says a measurable claim about a finish needs evidence that supports it. An endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not meet that standard.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
